S50Z26.today_summary: 1,050.4 settles 0.4 points above the 1,050 max-pain anchor with +599.8 of net dealer GEX inside 20 points of the money, the sixth straight session spot has closed on its own pain strike. 11.57% ATM IV prices a 7.65-point 1-sigma day, and the corridor between the -4,924.7 cumulative GEX trough at 1,040 and the 1,338-contract 1,100 call wall has contained every close in the window at 1,045.3-1,054.2, a span of 8.9 points. 1.01 P/C OI against 1.22 P/C volume says standing positioning is balanced while the session's 1,010 contracts of flow leaned put, 138 of them into the 1,020 put 30.4 points below spot. 1,791 contracts of put OI at 960 traded only 32 today and sit 8.6% below spot, so the deep floor is structural insurance rather than an active level.

S50Z26.five_day_thesis: The event that defines this window is the dealer-gamma sign flip at the money: -385.2 on 10-06, -402.0 on 10-07, -60.0 on 10-08, then +240.0 on 10-09 and +599.8 now, which turned the 1,050 strike from an amplifier into the chain's largest single stabiliser (+365.8 to +663.1 of GEX on +313 call OI). Max pain has not moved in six sessions (1,060 on 10-03, then 1,050 from 10-06 onward) and spot has closed inside an 8.9-point band for the whole stretch, which is the long-gamma shelf doing its work. Both walls are frozen: 1,100 calls (1,338 OI, +84) and 960 puts (1,791 OI, +299) have held their strikes across all 20 sessions on file, while the active inner put boundary migrated 1,040 to 1,000. IV has not compressed further - 11.18% on 10-06 to 11.57% now, +0.39 points - so the premium case rests on the frozen corridor and the 7.65-point 1-sigma, not on a vol collapse. The unresolved asymmetry is the -4,924.7 cumulative trough one strike below spot: the structure dampens at 1,050 and chases below 1,040, and 138 contracts of fresh 1,020 put volume are somebody paying for exactly that.

strategies.name: Iron condor 1000P / 980P x 1100C / 1120C
strategies.rationale: Sells the two boundaries the structure actually defends - the 979-contract 1,000 near-money put wall and the 1,338-contract 1,100 call wall where dealers carry +1,020.1 of long gamma - against a +599.8 ATM gamma shelf, a 1,050 pain anchor and an 8.9-point realised range over six sessions.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 20-point wing width minus net credit, per side (20 points = 4,000 baht at 200 baht/point). Only one side can finish in the money.
strategies.invalidation: A daily close below 1,040, where cumulative net GEX bottoms at -4,924.7 and dealer hedging switches from fading to chasing, or above the 1,100 call wall.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1040 / 1010
strategies.rationale: Buys the short-gamma shelf directly: every strike from 1,040 down to 960 carries negative net GEX (-204.5 at 1,040, -928.6 at 1,020, -1,048.7 at 1,000), so a break below 1,040 is amplified by dealer hedging rather than dampened - the same move the 138 contracts of 1,020 put volume are positioning for.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = the debit paid, capped at the 30-point spread width (6,000 baht at 200 baht/point) and realised in full if spot holds above 1,040.
strategies.invalidation: A daily close back above 1,060, where net GEX is +337.7 and call OI has grown +255 in five sessions, leaves the hedge paying pure premium decay against 77 days of theta.

strategies.name: Call credit spread 1100 / 1120
strategies.rationale: The single-sided version of the pin for a book unwilling to sell puts into fresh 1,020 put flow and a -0.78 skew: 1,100 is 49.6 points (4.7%) above spot, holds the chain's largest call OI at 1,338 contracts with +1,020.1 of dealer long gamma above it, and has not moved strike in 20 sessions.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 20-point width minus net credit (20 points = 4,000 baht at 200 baht/point).
strategies.invalidation: A daily close above 1,100 on expanding call volume, which would put spot inside the +4,311.5 long-gamma shelf with the 1,150 strike (1,082 OI, +220 in five sessions) as the next resistance.

S50Z26.prediction: 1,042.8-1,058.1 is the 1-sigma band for the next session off 1,050.4 and 7.65 points, and the +599.8 ATM gamma shelf sitting on a 1,050 pain anchor argues for more of the 8.9-point chop that has held for six sessions. A daily close below 1,040 invalidates that: cumulative net GEX is negative at every strike from 1,040 down to 960, so beneath it dealer hedging chases the move, with 1,020 (774 put OI) then 1,000 (979 put OI) the next shelves. 1,100 caps the other end - 1,338 contracts of call OI and +1,020.1 of dealer long gamma make a break through it grinding rather than explosive.
S50Z26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and nothing here is an instruction to execute a trade. SET50 options are cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind pinning are structurally weaker than for share-settled single stocks: treat the 1,050 pain anchor and the 1,040/1,100 corridor as tendencies, not guarantees, and especially so at 77 DTE where gamma is still small. Total chain volume was 1,010 contracts (455 calls, 555 puts), so the Vol2Vol filter clears only 1,020P (138), 1,040P (96), 1,060C (84) and 1,100C (74); the 1,791-contract 960 put wall traded 32 and sits 8.6% below spot, structural rather than live, and should not be weighted as support. Defined risk is not risk-free - every max loss quoted is in index points at 200 baht per point and can be realised in full, and the short-vol structures carry 77 days of vega against an 11.57% IV already near the window low. Data caveat: this run analyses the finalised 2026-10-13 chain; the 2026-10-14 pre-open scrape revised only IV and Greeks, leaving OI and volume unchanged.
